summary: Ambev S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting that its Board of Directors approved the cancellation of 279,000,000 treasury common shares, with no capital reduction, effective August 12-13, 2026. The cancellation reduces outstanding shares to 15,484,664,889. The board also noted completion of the October 29, 2025 buyback program, having reached its maximum authorized repurchases. The cancellation is a capital-return mechanism increasing per-share metrics; a shareholder meeting will resolve on amending Bylaws Article 5. Watch for possible further buybacks or special dividends.
